SDP::field
Description
This command will return the value of a specific SDP field
Syntax
SDP
::
field
field-name
<
index
>
# introduced in v13
SDP
::
field
field-name
<
index
>
<
new
value
>
SDP::field
field-name <index>
Get SDP field “field-name” at position index, if index is not
present, the first field “field-name” will be returned if found
SDP::field
field-name <index> <new value>
Sets SDP field “field-name” at position index with user defined “new
value”
Examples
log
local0.
"SDP field: [SDP::field connection_address]"
when
SIP_REQUEST
{
log
local0.
"SDP field b: [SDP::field b]"
SDP
::
field
c
0
"IN IP4 10.10.1.150"
}
